    STU.fixes=fixes;
    var rerr=await stuRunTest(code),rt=0;
    while(rerr&&rt<2){
      rt++;
      var rh=[{role:"user",parts:[{text:"Your app throws this error when actually run in a browser: "+rerr+" - return the FULL corrected complete app (single HTML file) with this error fixed."}]},{role:"user",parts:[{text:code}]}];
      out=await callGeminiFast("",rh,false,STU_PROMPT);
      var c3=stuExtract(out);
      if(!c3)break;
      code=c3;rerr=await stuRunTest(code);
    }
    STU.rt=rt;
    STU.code=code;
    STU.hist=STU.hist.concat([{role:"user",parts:[{text:prompt}]}]).slice(-6);
